# Adventuring gear

80 items · 8 tables · source: SRD D&D 2024

Adventuring gear A–Z, then the variant tables (ammunition, focuses, holy symbols) and the mounts and vehicles
tables as printed. `cost_gp` and `weight_lb` are numbers for sorting; blank when the cost or weight varies.
Tools: [tools.md](tools.md).
